afternoon to 23.5 feet just after midnight tonight. It will
continue to rise to 27.0 feet early Friday morning. It will then
fall below flood stage early Saturday morning.

feet on 02/03/2012.

properties.title: Flood Warning issued September 2 at 10:35AM CDT until September 3 at 4:00PM CDT by NWS Houston/Galveston TX
properties.description:
...The National Weather Service in Houston/Galveston has issued a
Flood Warning for the following rivers in Texas...

Long King Creek near Livingston affecting Polk and San Jacinto
Counties.

For the Long King Creek...including Livingston...Minor flooding is
forecast.

* WHAT...Minor flooding is occurring and minor flooding is forecast.

* WHERE...Long King Creek near Livingston.

* WHEN...From this morning to Thursday afternoon.

* IMPACTS...At 19.0 feet, At levels above 19 feet, minor lowland
flooding begins as water escapes the main channel of the creek. At
25.0 feet, At levels above 25 feet, moderate lowland flooding
begins as low-lying areas along the creek become inundated.

* ADDITIONAL DETAILS...
- At 9:30 AM CDT Wednesday the stage was 19.4 feet.
- Bankfull stage is 14.0 feet.
- Recent Activity...The maximum river stage in the 24 hours ending
at 9:30 AM CDT Wednesday was 19.4 feet.
- Forecast...The river is expected to rise to a crest of 23.1 feet
this evening. It will then fall below flood stage late tonight.
- Flood stage is 19.0 feet.
- Flood History...This crest compares to a previous crest of 23.2
feet on 07/27/2024.
- http://www.weather.gov/safety/flood

through flooded areas.

properties.title: Flood Advisory issued September 2 at 6:46AM MST until September 2 at 6:45PM MST by NWS Tucson AZ
properties.description:
* WHAT...Arroyo and small stream flooding caused by runoff from
previous days' rain. The Vamori Wash at Kom Vo is at 9.51 ft, which
is action stage.

* WHERE...Southwestern Pima County in southeastern Arizona,
specifically the Vamori Wash.

* WHEN...Until 645 PM MST Wednesday.

* IMPACTS...Water may be approaching the bottom of the Highway 21
Bridge that goes over the Vamori.

* ADDITIONAL DETAILS...
- At 641 AM MST, gauge reports indicated heavy rain due to
thunderstorms. This  will cause arroyo and small stream flooding.
- This includes the following streams and drainages...
Hali Murk Wash, Vamori Wash, San Luis Wash, Gu Vo Wash, Gu Oidak
Wash, San Simon Wash and Sells Wash.
- Some locations that will experience flooding include...
Santa Cruz and Kupk.
- http://www.weather.gov/safety/flood

deaths occur in vehicles.
